channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Retired baker turns passion into thriving New Forest Shortbread business
item.description: A New Forest baker who began making shortbread in her cottage kitchen after retiring is now seeing her treats stocked in pubs across the Forest.

item.title: Council rent and housing charges set to rise - but heating costs to reduce
item.description: Council rents and housing charges in Southampton are set to increase – but heating costs are expected to drop.

item.title: Councillor campaigns for new splash park to be built in Southampton
item.description: A petition has been launched by a councillor calling for a new splash park to be built at Mansel Park in Millbrook.

item.title: Cruise that departs from Southampton named among world's best to travel on
item.description: The Southampton to New York westbound transatlantic crossing has been named among the world's best cruises to travel on

item.title: Police raise safety concerns as new crossings to be installed on busy road
item.description: Six raised crossings are set to be installed on side roads along Mortimers Lane in Fair Oak as part of a major walking and cycling scheme, but police have warned they could create a risk of collisions.

item.title: Woman admits possessing fighting dog and stealing from shops
item.description: A woman has admitted possessing a fighting dog as well as committing a spate of shoplifting offences

item.title: Petition launched to cancel 'unfair' parking fines at West Quay Retail Park
item.description: A row has erupted over parking fines at West Quay Retail Park, with a councillor launching a petition calling for charges issued after 8pm to be cancelled.

item.title: Man who threatened to burn down pub hauled before court for breach
item.description: A man who threatened to burn down a pub has again appeared in court after failing to abide by his sentence

item.title: Video shows driver speeding down road moments before killing woman in crash
item.description: A video has been released showing a man speeding down the road moments before a fatal collision

item.title: Audi driver avoids jail after killing woman in crash
item.description: A man has walked free from court after being found guilty at trial of crashing into and killing a woman in Southampton
